question: Should Workspaces permanently expose `bus:pubsub` as a supported capability for approved custom widgets?
rationale: This is a new API and security surface for untrusted widget code rather than a repair to established behavior, so tests can establish correctness but not whether OpenClaw should commit to the contract.

options.title: Sponsor the capability
options.body: Adopt the parent-brokered same-tab API after current-main refresh and convincing real-browser security and lifecycle proof.

options.title: Defer widget coordination
options.body: Keep custom widgets isolated until maintainers approve a broader long-term widget composition contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the capability
recommendation.body: Adopt the parent-brokered same-tab API after current-main refresh and convincing real-browser security and lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current Workspaces architecture and are the strongest history owner for its custom-widget contract.
